CREATE VIEW dbo.V_EVALUATION_COMPETENCE
AS
SELECT        TOP (100) PERCENT dbo.Examen_Competence_Cible.ExamenCompetenceCible_ExamenId, dbo.Examen_Competence_Cible.ExamenCompetenceCible_CompetenceCibleId, 
                         dbo.Examen_Competence_Cible.ExamenCompetenceCible_Ordre, dbo.Evaluation_Competence.EvaluationCompetence_Score, dbo.Evaluation_Competence.EvaluationCompetence_MatiereId, 
                         dbo.Evaluation_Competence.EvaluationCompetence_EtudiantId, dbo.CompetanceCible.CompetanceCible_Description, dbo.Evaluation_Competence.EvaluationCompetence_ClasseId, dbo.Matiere.Matiere_DefinitionComplet, 
                         dbo.Examen.Classe_ID, dbo.Classe.Classe_Libelle, dbo.Etudiant_Niveau_Annee.EtudiantNiveauAnnee_ID, dbo.Annee.Annee_Encours
FROM            dbo.Examen_Competence_Cible INNER JOIN
                         dbo.Evaluation_Competence ON dbo.Examen_Competence_Cible.ExamenCompetenceCible_ExamenId = dbo.Evaluation_Competence.EvaluationCompetence_ExamenId AND 
                         dbo.Examen_Competence_Cible.ExamenCompetenceCible_CompetenceCibleId = dbo.Evaluation_Competence.EvaluationCompetence_CompetenceId INNER JOIN
                         dbo.CompetanceCible ON dbo.Examen_Competence_Cible.ExamenCompetenceCible_CompetenceCibleId = dbo.CompetanceCible.CompetanceCible_Id INNER JOIN
                         dbo.Matiere ON dbo.Evaluation_Competence.EvaluationCompetence_MatiereId = dbo.Matiere.Matiere_ID INNER JOIN
                         dbo.Examen ON dbo.Evaluation_Competence.EvaluationCompetence_ExamenId = dbo.Examen.Examen_ID INNER JOIN
                         dbo.Classe ON dbo.Examen.Classe_ID = dbo.Classe.Classe_ID INNER JOIN
                         dbo.Etudiant_Niveau_Annee ON dbo.Evaluation_Competence.EvaluationCompetence_EtudiantId = dbo.Etudiant_Niveau_Annee.Etudiant_ID INNER JOIN
                         dbo.Annee ON dbo.Etudiant_Niveau_Annee.Annee_ID = dbo.Annee.Annee_ID
WHERE        (dbo.Annee.Annee_Encours = 1)
ORDER BY dbo.Examen_Competence_Cible.ExamenCompetenceCible_Ordre

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[VAbsenceMatiere]
AS
SELECT        dbo.Absence.EtudiantNiveauAnnee_ID, dbo.Absence.Absence_Date_Du, dbo.Absence.Absence_Date_Au, dbo.Absence.Matiere_ID, dbo.Matiere.Matiere_Definition
FROM            dbo.Absence INNER JOIN
                         dbo.Matiere ON dbo.Absence.Matiere_ID = dbo.Matiere.Matiere_ID

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[VCondultation_Parent_Etudiant]
AS
SELECT        dbo.Parent.Parent_ID, dbo.Parent.UserName, dbo.Etudiant.Etudiant_Photo, dbo.Etudiant_Niveau_Annee.EtudiantNiveauAnnee_ID, dbo.Etudiant.Etudiant_ID, dbo.Etudiant.Etudiant_Nom, dbo.Etudiant.Etudiant_Prenom, 
                         dbo.Etudiant_Classe.Classe_ID, dbo.Classe.Classe_Libelle, dbo.Annee.Annee_Libelle, dbo.Annee.Annee_Encours, dbo.Parent.Parent_Code, dbo.Etudiant.Etudiant_DateNaissance, dbo.Niveau.Niveau_Libelle
FROM            dbo.Etudiant_Niveau_Annee INNER JOIN
                         dbo.Etudiant ON dbo.Etudiant_Niveau_Annee.Etudiant_ID = dbo.Etudiant.Etudiant_ID INNER JOIN
                         dbo.Parent INNER JOIN
                         dbo.Etudiant_Parent ON dbo.Parent.Parent_ID = dbo.Etudiant_Parent.Parent_ID ON dbo.Etudiant_Niveau_Annee.EtudiantNiveauAnnee_ID = dbo.Etudiant_Parent.Etudiant_ID INNER JOIN
                         dbo.Etudiant_Classe ON dbo.Etudiant_Niveau_Annee.EtudiantNiveauAnnee_ID = dbo.Etudiant_Classe.EtudiantNiveauAnnee_ID INNER JOIN
                         dbo.Classe ON dbo.Etudiant_Classe.Classe_ID = dbo.Classe.Classe_ID INNER JOIN
                         dbo.Annee ON dbo.Etudiant_Niveau_Annee.Annee_ID = dbo.Annee.Annee_ID INNER JOIN
                         dbo.Niveau ON dbo.Etudiant_Niveau_Annee.Niveau_ID = dbo.Niveau.Niveau_ID
WHERE        (dbo.Annee.Annee_Encours = 1)

CREATE VIEW dbo.VConsultation_MessageDirection
AS
SELECT        dbo.Message.Message_ID, dbo.Message.EtudiantNiveauAnnee_ID, dbo.Message.Message_Text, dbo.Message.Message_DateCreation, dbo.Message.Message_PieceJointe, dbo.Message.Message_TypeId, 
                         dbo.Type_Message.TypeMessage_Libelle, dbo.Message.Message_Titre, dbo.Message.Message_ClasseId, dbo.Classe.Classe_Libelle, dbo.Etudiant.Etudiant_Nom, dbo.Etudiant.Etudiant_Prenom, dbo.Message.Message_URL, 
                         dbo.Message.Message_Guid
FROM            dbo.Message INNER JOIN
                         dbo.Type_Message ON dbo.Message.Message_TypeId = dbo.Type_Message.TypeMessage_Id INNER JOIN
                         dbo.Classe ON dbo.Message.Message_ClasseId = dbo.Classe.Classe_ID INNER JOIN
                         dbo.Etudiant_Niveau_Annee ON dbo.Message.EtudiantNiveauAnnee_ID = dbo.Etudiant_Niveau_Annee.EtudiantNiveauAnnee_ID INNER JOIN
                         dbo.Etudiant ON dbo.Etudiant_Niveau_Annee.Etudiant_ID = dbo.Etudiant.Etudiant_ID

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[VConsultation_Resultat_Apprentissage]
AS
SELECT        dbo.Resultat_Apprentissage.ResultatApprentissage_Id, dbo.Resultat_Apprentissage.ResultatApprentissage_EtudiantNiveauAnnee_Id, dbo.Etudiant_Niveau_Annee.Etudiant_ID, dbo.Etudiant.Etudiant_Nom, 
                         dbo.Etudiant.Etudiant_Prenom, dbo.Resultat_Apprentissage.ResultatApprentissage_ComposanteCours_Id, dbo.Composante_Cours.ComposanteCours_Lecon, dbo.Composante_Cours.ComposanteCours_MatiereId, 
                         dbo.Matiere.Matiere_DefinitionComplet, dbo.Composante_Cours.ComposanteCours_NiveauId, dbo.Niveau.Niveau_Libelle, dbo.Resultat_Apprentissage.ResultatApprentissage_Iteration, 
                         dbo.Resultat_Apprentissage.ResultatApprentissage_Niveau, dbo.Niveau_Apprentissage.NiveauApprentissage_Libelle, dbo.Etudiant_Classe.Classe_ID, dbo.Classe.Classe_Libelle, 
                         dbo.Resultat_Apprentissage.ResultatApprentissage_Date, dbo.Composante_Cours.ComposanteCours_IsActive, dbo.Composante_Cours.ComposanteCours_Semestre
FROM            dbo.Niveau_Apprentissage INNER JOIN
                         dbo.Etudiant INNER JOIN
                         dbo.Etudiant_Niveau_Annee ON dbo.Etudiant.Etudiant_ID = dbo.Etudiant_Niveau_Annee.Etudiant_ID INNER JOIN
                         dbo.Resultat_Apprentissage ON dbo.Etudiant_Niveau_Annee.EtudiantNiveauAnnee_ID = dbo.Resultat_Apprentissage.ResultatApprentissage_EtudiantNiveauAnnee_Id ON 
                         dbo.Niveau_Apprentissage.NiveauApprentissage_Id = dbo.Resultat_Apprentissage.ResultatApprentissage_Niveau INNER JOIN
                         dbo.Etudiant_Classe ON dbo.Etudiant_Niveau_Annee.EtudiantNiveauAnnee_ID = dbo.Etudiant_Classe.EtudiantNiveauAnnee_ID INNER JOIN
                         dbo.Classe ON dbo.Etudiant_Classe.Classe_ID = dbo.Classe.Classe_ID RIGHT OUTER JOIN
                         dbo.Matiere INNER JOIN
                         dbo.Composante_Cours ON dbo.Matiere.Matiere_ID = dbo.Composante_Cours.ComposanteCours_MatiereId INNER JOIN
                         dbo.Niveau ON dbo.Composante_Cours.ComposanteCours_NiveauId = dbo.Niveau.Niveau_ID ON dbo.Resultat_Apprentissage.ResultatApprentissage_ComposanteCours_Id = dbo.Composante_Cours.ComposanteCours_Id
